items.title: Optimised oxygenation improves functional capacity during ...
items.summary: An RCT demonstrated that optimized oxygenation improved functional capacity during daily activities in patients with COPD on long-term oxygen therapy.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机交叉试验显示，优化氧合能改善长期氧疗 COPD 患者日常活动的功能能力。这基本坐实了在长期氧疗中，优化氧合对改善患者生活质量和功能独立的价值。你在临床中应充分评估患者氧合状态，并考虑调整氧疗方案以达到最佳功能效益。
items.titleZh: 优化氧合改善长期氧疗 COPD 患者日常活动的功能能力：一项随机交叉试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机交叉试验表明，优化氧合改善了长期氧疗的慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）患者在日常活动中的功能能力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized crossover trial showed that optimized oxygenation improves functional capacity during daily activities in COPD patients on long-term oxygen therapy. This essentially confirms the value of optimized oxygenation in improving quality of life and functional independence for patients on long-term oxygen therapy. In clinical practice, you should fully assess patients' oxygenation status and consider adjusting oxygen therapy to achieve optimal functional benefits.
items.limitation: 这是一项交叉试验，虽然有助于减少个体差异，但可能存在残余效应。
items.limitationEn: This was a crossover trial, which, while reducing individual variability, might have carryover effects.

items.title: Changes in Urgency Urinary Incontinence Symptoms After Stress Urinary Incontinence Surgery in Women | International Urogynecology Journal
items.summary: An observational study investigated changes in urgency urinary incontinence symptoms after stress urinary incontinence surgery in women, noting potential improvements, worsening, or de novo onset.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究发现压力性尿失禁手术可能改善或加重急迫性尿失禁症状，甚至引起新发症状。在术前咨询时，务必告知患者这些潜在风险，并强调术后对急迫性症状的持续评估和管理的重要性。
items.titleZh: 女性压力性尿失禁手术后急迫性尿失禁症状的变化
items.summaryZh: 一项观察性研究探讨了女性压力性尿失禁手术后急迫性尿失禁症状的变化，指出可能改善、恶化或新发。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study found that stress urinary incontinence surgery can either improve or worsen urgency urinary incontinence symptoms, or even cause de novo symptoms. During preoperative counseling, it is crucial to inform patients about these potential risks and emphasize the importance of ongoing assessment and management of urgency symptoms post-surgery.
items.limitation: 该研究为观察性研究，未能明确说明因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This observational study did not clearly establish causality.

items.summary: A study found associations between diaphragmatic crus thickness assessed by CT and diaphragmatic excursion and exercise capacity in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现 COPD 患者膈肌脚厚度与膈肌活动度和运动能力相关。这提示你，CT 评估膈肌脚厚度可能成为评估 COPD 患者膈肌功能和运动耐量的潜在指标，辅助你的康复评估。

items.curatedReasonEn: This study found that diaphragmatic crus thickness in COPD patients is associated with diaphragmatic excursion and exercise capacity. This suggests that CT assessment of diaphragmatic crus thickness could be a potential indicator for evaluating diaphragmatic function and exercise tolerance in COPD patients, aiding your rehabilitation assessment.
items.limitation: 该研究为横断面设计，无法确立因果关系，且 CT 评估膈肌脚厚度的临床实用性尚需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a cross-sectional study, unable to establish causality, and the clinical utility of CT assessment of diaphragmatic crus thickness needs further validation.

items.curatedReason: 这项研究利用潜在类别分析揭示了背痛患者中可修改的健康风险模式。了解这些模式能帮助你更精准地识别和干预患者的共病风险，优化康复策略。
items.titleZh: 背痛患者中可修改的健康风险模式：一项潜在类别分析
items.summaryZh: 一项潜在类别分析在背痛患者中识别了可修改的健康风险模式，为共病概况提供了见解。
items.curatedReasonEn: You need to identify comorbidity risks in back pain patients more precisely. This latent class analysis reveals multiple modifiable health-risk patterns. Understanding these patterns will help you tailor intervention plans and improve rehabilitation outcomes.
items.limitation: 潜在类别分析为观察性研究，无法直接建立因果关系，且结果可能受限于所纳入变量。
items.limitationEn: Latent class analysis is observational and cannot establish direct causality; results may be limited by included variables.

items.title: Single-session pelvic prehabilitation improves continence recovery after robot-assisted radical prostatectomy: a prospective comparative study | Journal of Robotic Surgery
items.summary: A prospective comparative study found that single-session pelvic prehabilitation improved continence recovery after robot-assisted radical prostatectomy.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性比较研究显示，单次盆底肌康复训练能显著改善机器人辅助根治性前列腺切除术后的控尿恢复。这支持了将术前盆底康复纳入前列腺癌患者术前路径，即使是单次干预也值得推荐。
items.titleZh: 单次盆底术前康复训练改善机器人辅助根治性前列腺切除术后控尿恢复：一项前瞻性比较研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性比较研究发现，单次盆底术前康复训练改善了机器人辅助根治性前列腺切除术后患者的控尿恢复。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective comparative study indicates that a single session of pelvic prehabilitation significantly improves continence recovery after robot-assisted radical prostatectomy. This supports integrating preoperative pelvic rehabilitation into the prostatectomy pathway, even a single intervention is recommendable.
items.limitation: 研究设计为前瞻性比较研究，而非随机对照，可能存在混杂因素影响结果。
items.limitationEn: The study design is a prospective comparative study, not an RCT, which may introduce confounding factors.

items.title: Bypass neural interfaces for paralysis: clinical translation, challenges and future directions | Journal of NeuroEngineering and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A review examined the clinical translation, challenges, and future directions of neural bypass interfaces for paralysis, emphasizing their potential for functional recovery.
items.curatedReason: 作为神经康复医师，你必须了解神经旁路接口在截瘫治疗中的前沿进展。这篇综述详细阐述了其临床转化、挑战及未来方向，明确指出这些技术是为严重瘫痪患者带来功能恢复希望的重要途径，是未来康复治疗的关键领域。
items.titleZh: 截瘫的神经旁路接口：临床转化、挑战与未来方向
items.summaryZh: 一篇综述探讨了用于截瘫的神经旁路接口的临床转化、挑战与未来方向，强调了其功能恢复的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: As a neurorehabilitation clinician, you must understand the cutting-edge advancements of neural bypass interfaces for paralysis. This review details their clinical translation, challenges, and future directions, clearly stating that these technologies are a critical path to functional recovery for severely paralyzed patients and a key area for future rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 作为综述，其内容综合现有文献，但具体技术成熟度和临床应用仍处于发展阶段，存在不确定性。
items.limitationEn: As a review, it synthesizes existing literature, but the maturity and clinical application of specific technologies are still developing and subject to uncertainty.

items.title: Reprogramming microglia via ShK-modified extracellular vesicles promotes immunomodulation and functional recovery after spinal cord injury | Journal of Nanobiotechnology
items.summary: Research showed that reprogramming microglia via ShK-modified extracellular vesicles promoted immunomodulation and functional recovery after spinal cord injury in animal models.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现通过 ShK 修饰的细胞外囊泡重编程小胶质细胞，能促进脊髓损伤后的免疫调节和功能恢复。虽然仍处于基础研究阶段，这为脊髓损伤康复提供了新的靶点和生物治疗方向。
items.titleZh: ShK 修饰细胞外囊泡重编程小胶质细胞促进脊髓损伤后免疫调节和功能恢复
items.summaryZh: 研究表明，通过 ShK 修饰的细胞外囊泡重编程小胶质细胞，能促进脊髓损伤动物模型中的免疫调节和功能恢复。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found that reprogramming microglia via ShK-modified extracellular vesicles promotes immunomodulation and functional recovery after spinal cord injury. While still in basic research, this offers new targets and biological therapeutic directions for spinal cord injury rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为动物模型研究，其结果在人体中的转化和临床疗效尚待验证。
items.limitationEn: This study was conducted in animal models, and its translation to human application and clinical efficacy still need to be verified.

items.title: Predictors of discharge destination of stroke patients from inpatient rehabilitation center, including difficult discharge cases | Egyptian Rheumatology and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A study identified predictors of discharge destination for stroke patients from inpatient rehabilitation centers, including difficult discharge cases, to aid early planning.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究探讨了卒中患者从住院康复中心出院去向的预测因素，包括难治性出院案例。了解这些预测因子能帮助你早期识别高风险患者，提前规划出院路径，减少延迟出院的发生。
items.titleZh: 卒中患者从住院康复中心出院去向的预测因素，包括难治性出院案例
items.summaryZh: 一项研究识别了卒中患者从住院康复中心出院去向的预测因素，包括难治性出院案例，以帮助早期规划。
items.curatedReasonEn: In inpatient rehabilitation for stroke patients, you need to plan discharge pathways earlier. This study identified factors predicting patient discharge destinations, including difficult discharge cases. Understanding this information will help you intervene proactively and reduce unnecessary hospitalization time.
items.limitation: 研究设计为观察性研究，可能存在未考虑的混杂因素，且结果外推性受限于单中心数据。
items.limitationEn: The study design is observational, potentially affected by unconsidered confounding factors, and generalizability is limited by single-center data.

items.title: Diagnostic accuracy of biodex balance system stability indices under single- and dual-task conditions in individuals with chronic ankle instability | BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A study evaluated the diagnostic accuracy of Biodex balance system stability indices under single- and dual-task conditions in individuals with chronic ankle instability.
items.curatedReason: 如果你在评估慢性踝关节不稳患者的平衡功能，请注意在双任务条件下进行测试。这项研究表明，Biodex 平衡系统稳定性指标在双任务条件下能更准确地诊断 CAI 患者的平衡缺陷，比单任务测试更具临床价值。
items.titleZh: 慢性踝关节不稳患者 Biodex 平衡系统稳定性指标在单任务和双任务条件下的诊断准确性
items.summaryZh: 一项研究评估了慢性踝关节不稳患者在单任务和双任务条件下，Biodex 平衡系统稳定性指标的诊断准确性。
items.curatedReasonEn: If you are assessing balance function in patients with chronic ankle instability, consider testing under dual-task conditions. This study shows that Biodex Balance System stability indices provide more accurate diagnostic information for balance deficits in CAI patients under dual-task conditions, offering greater clinical value than single-task tests.
items.limitation: 本研究为诊断准确性研究，样本量可能限制了其普适性，且需要进一步验证其在不同人群中的有效性。
items.limitationEn: This diagnostic accuracy study may have limited generalizability due to sample size, and its effectiveness in diverse populations requires further validation.

items.curatedReason: 这篇博客文章总结了对运动中肌肉拉伤情境特征的研究。了解肌肉拉伤的实际发生模式，能帮助你优化预防策略和重返运动方案，更精准地评估风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: To prevent muscle strains in sports more effectively and design return-to-sport programs, you must understand the actual situational characteristics of muscle strains. This blog post summarizes relevant research and will help you assess risks more precisely, avoiding ineffective interventions.
items.limitation: 博客文章是基于现有研究的总结，但并未提供原始研究的具体数据和方法学细节。
items.limitationEn: The blog post summarizes existing research but does not provide specific data or detailed methodology from the original studies.

items.title: Single leg vertical jump performance identifies knee ...
items.summary: Single leg vertical jump performance identified knee function deficits at return to sport after ACL reconstruction in male athletes.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，单腿垂直跳表现可以识别男性运动员 ACL 重建术后重返运动时的膝关节功能缺陷。将其作为评估指标，可以更早、更客观地发现问题，指导你的康复和训练计划。
items.titleZh: 单腿垂直跳表现可识别男性运动员 ACL 重建术后重返运动时的膝关节功能缺陷
items.summaryZh: 研究发现，单腿垂直跳表现能识别男性运动员前交叉韧带重建术后重返运动时存在的膝关节功能缺陷。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that single leg vertical jump performance can identify knee function deficits at return to sport after ACL reconstruction in male athletes. Using it as an assessment metric allows you to detect issues earlier and more objectively, guiding your rehabilitation and training plans.
items.limitation: 该研究关注男性运动员，结果对外推至女性运动员或其他人群时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on male athletes, so results should be cautiously generalized to female athletes or other populations.

items.title: Distinct Movement-Related Cortical Control Following Anterior Cruciate Ligament Injury: A Scoping Review | Sports Medicine - Open
items.summary: A scoping review synthesized evidence on distinct movement-related cortical control following anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) injury, highlighting neural differences during motor tasks.
items.curatedReason: ACL 损伤不仅仅是膝关节问题，它还会导致运动相关的皮质控制发生变化。这篇综述提醒我们，在康复过程中，除了关注局部生物力学，也应留意患者的神经认知层面，因为这可能影响其运动表现和最终康复效果。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带损伤后独特的运动相关皮质控制：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述综合了前交叉韧带（ACL）损伤后独特的运动相关皮质控制的证据，强调了运动任务中的神经差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: ACL injury is not just a knee joint problem; it also leads to changes in movement-related cortical control. This review reminds us that during rehabilitation, in addition to focusing on local biomechanics, we should also pay attention to patients' neurocognitive aspects, as this may affect their motor performance and ultimate rehabilitation outcomes.
items.limitation: 作为范围综述，其目的在于映射研究范围而非系统评估证据质量或汇总效应量。
items.limitationEn: As a scoping review, its purpose is to map the research landscape rather than systematically evaluate evidence quality or synthesize effect sizes.

items.title: Prevalence and risk factors of medial meniscal ramp lesions in patients undergoing primary anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction at a tertiary center | Journal of Orthopaedic Surgery and Research
items.summary: A study investigated the prevalence and risk factors of medial meniscal ramp lesions in patients undergoing primary anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction at a tertiary center.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究调查了初次 ACL 重建术患者内侧半月板斜坡损伤的患病率和风险因素。了解这些信息能帮助你在术前评估中提高警惕，及早发现并处理潜在的半月板损伤，优化术后康复。
items.titleZh: 三级中心初次前交叉韧带重建术患者内侧半月板斜坡损伤的患病率及风险因素
items.summaryZh: 一项研究调查了在三级中心进行初次前交叉韧带重建术的患者中，内侧半月板斜坡损伤的患病率和风险因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: When conducting preoperative assessments for primary ACL reconstruction, you need to be vigilant about medial meniscal ramp lesions. This study investigated their prevalence and risk factors, and understanding this information can help you detect and address these potential injuries early, optimizing postoperative rehabilitation outcomes.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性观察性研究，可能存在选择偏倚和混杂因素，结果仍需前瞻性研究验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective observational study, potentially subject to selection bias and confounding factors, and results require validation by prospective studies.

items.title: Outcome indicators and effectiveness of nutrition education for athletes: a systematic review | BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A systematic review assessed outcome indicators and effectiveness of nutrition education for athletes, highlighting its role in performance and injury prevention.
items.curatedReason: 营养教育在运动员表现和伤病预防中扮演着关键角色，你不应忽视。这项系统综述评估了营养教育的有效性和结局指标，提示你应与营养师紧密协作，或将有效的营养知识整合到康复计划中，以提升整体治疗效果。
items.titleZh: 运动员营养教育的结局指标和有效性：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述评估了运动员营养教育的结局指标和有效性，强调其在运动表现和损伤预防中的作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: Nutrition education plays a crucial role in athlete performance and injury prevention, and you should not overlook it. This systematic review assessed the effectiveness and outcome indicators of nutrition education, suggesting that you should collaborate closely with dietitians or integrate effective nutritional knowledge into rehabilitation plans to enhance overall treatment outcomes.
items.limitation: 综述的质量和结论强度取决于纳入研究的异质性和质量。
items.limitationEn: The quality and strength of conclusions of a systematic review depend on the heterogeneity and quality of included studies.

items.title: Biomechanical effects of powered knee orthoses and articulated ankle-foot orthoses in people with diparetic cerebral palsy: a pilot study | Journal of NeuroEngineering and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A pilot study investigated biomechanical effects of powered knee orthoses and articulated ankle-foot orthoses in people with diparetic cerebral palsy, showing potential gait improvements.
items.curatedReason: 这些动力膝关节矫形器和踝足矫形器可能改善双瘫脑瘫患者的步态。这项初步研究提示，在儿童脑瘫康复中，可将这类辅助设备作为改善其步态的潜在干预手段。
items.titleZh: 动力膝关节矫形器和关节式踝足矫形器对双瘫脑瘫患者的生物力学效应：一项初步研究
items.summaryZh: 一项初步研究调查了动力膝关节矫形器和关节式踝足矫形器对双瘫脑瘫患者的生物力学效应，显示出潜在的步态改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: These powered knee orthoses and articulated ankle-foot orthoses may improve gait in people with diparetic cerebral palsy. This pilot study suggests that these assistive devices could be a potential intervention to improve gait in pediatric cerebral palsy rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为初步研究，样本量小，需要更大规模的临床试验来验证其长期疗效和普适性。
items.limitationEn: This was a pilot study with a small sample size, requiring larger clinical trials to validate long-term efficacy and generalizability.

items.title: Can slow and (un)steady still win the race? A narrative review of developmental gait characteristics and clinical implications in children born preterm | European Journal of Pediatrics
items.summary: A narrative review discussed developmental gait characteristics and clinical implications in children born preterm, emphasizing the integration of neuromuscular maturation and postural control.
items.curatedReason: 评估早产儿步态时，你必须充分考虑其独特的发育轨迹和神经肌肉成熟问题。这篇综述提醒我们，早产儿的步态干预需要整合神经肌肉成熟和姿势控制的考量。
items.titleZh: 慢而（不）稳也能赢？早产儿发育性步态特征及临床意义的叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 一篇叙述性综述讨论了早产儿的发育性步态特征及其临床意义，强调了神经肌肉成熟和姿势控制的整合。
items.curatedReasonEn: When assessing gait in preterm children, you must fully consider their unique developmental trajectory and neuromuscular maturation issues. This review reminds us that gait interventions for preterm infants need to integrate considerations of neuromuscular maturation and postural control.
items.limitation: 本综述为叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚，且未进行系统性证据质量评估。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, which may be subject to selection bias and did not undergo systematic evidence quality assessment.

items.title: Age- and sex-specific percentile curves for gross and fine motor skills in early childhood: an analysis from the SUNRISE International Study | European Journal of Pediatrics
items.summary: An analysis from the SUNRISE International Study provided age- and sex-specific percentile curves for gross and fine motor skills in early childhood.
items.curatedReason: SUNRISE 国际研究提供了儿童早期粗大和精细运动技能的年龄和性别特异性百分位曲线。你现在有了评估不同背景下儿童运动发育水平的标准化参考框架。
items.titleZh: 儿童早期粗大和精细运动技能的年龄和性别特异性百分位曲线：SUNRISE 国际研究分析
items.summaryZh: SUNRISE 国际研究的一项分析提供了儿童早期粗大和精细运动技能的年龄和性别特异性百分位曲线。
items.curatedReasonEn: The SUNRISE International Study provides age- and sex-specific percentile curves for gross and fine motor skills in early childhood. You now have a standardized reference framework for assessing motor development levels in children from diverse backgrounds.
items.limitation: 研究数据主要来自高收入国家，结果在外推至低收入和中等收入国家时可能存在局限性。
items.limitationEn: The study data primarily derived from high-income countries, limiting generalizability to low- and middle-income countries.

items.title: Associations of uric acid with wearable sensor-derived digital gait characteristics in older adults: vigor, symmetry, and stability | BMC Geriatrics
items.summary: A study found associations of uric acid levels with wearable sensor-derived digital gait characteristics (vigor, symmetry, and stability) in older adults.
items.curatedReason: 尿酸水平可能与老年人的步态活力、对称性和稳定性相关。这项研究提示，尿酸或许能作为识别步态异常高风险老年患者的生物标志物，值得你在临床中留意。
items.titleZh: 老年人尿酸与可穿戴传感器衍生的数字步态特征（活力、对称性和稳定性）的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项研究发现老年人的尿酸水平与可穿戴传感器衍生的数字步态特征（活力、对称性和稳定性）之间存在关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: Uric acid levels may be associated with gait vigor, symmetry, and stability in older adults. This study suggests that uric acid could serve as a biomarker to identify older patients at high risk for gait abnormalities, which is worth noting in your clinical practice.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立尿酸与步态特征之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This was a cross-sectional study, which cannot establish a causal relationship between uric acid and gait characteristics.

items.title: Low-load blood flow restriction training vs high-load resistance training for sarcopenia in older adults: a literature review | Sport Sciences for Health
items.summary: A literature review compared low-load blood flow restriction training with high-load resistance training for sarcopenia in older adults.
items.curatedReason: 这篇文献综述比较了老年肌少症患者的低负荷血流限制训练与高负荷抗阻训练。它帮助你理解血流限制训练作为传统高负荷训练替代方案的潜力，在临床中为肌少症患者提供更多选择，尤其适用于无法承受高负荷的患者。
items.titleZh: 老年肌少症患者的低负荷血流限制训练与高负荷抗阻训练：一篇文献综述
items.summaryZh: 一篇文献综述比较了老年肌少症患者的低负荷血流限制训练与高负荷抗阻训练。
items.curatedReasonEn: For older adults with sarcopenia, especially those unable to tolerate high-load training, low-load blood flow restriction training is worth considering. This review provides evidence for blood flow restriction training as an alternative to high-load training, expanding your clinical options.
items.limitation: 作为文献综述，其结论的强度取决于所纳入研究的质量，且可能存在发表偏倚。
items.limitationEn: As a literature review, the strength of its conclusions depends on the quality of included studies, and publication bias may exist.

items.title: Exploratory analysis of a Phase I cardiac rehabilitation pathway on anxiety and autonomy in patients undergoing PCI: a narrative nursing and transactional stress-coping perspective | BMC Cardiovascular Disorders
items.summary: An exploratory secondary analysis of an RCT investigated associations of a Phase I cardiac rehabilitation pathway on anxiety and autonomy in patients undergoing PCI.
items.curatedReason: 尽管是二次分析，但这项研究提示，PCI 术后的 I 期心脏康复可能对患者的焦虑和自主性有积极影响。你在实践中不仅要关注生理康复，也要重视其对患者心理健康的潜在益处。
items.titleZh: PCI 患者心脏康复路径对焦虑和自主性影响的探索性分析：叙述性护理与交易性应激应对视角
items.summaryZh: 一项对随机对照试验的探索性二次分析调查了 PCI 患者心脏康复路径对焦虑和自主性的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: Despite being a secondary analysis, this study suggests that Phase I cardiac rehabilitation after PCI may have positive effects on patients' anxiety and autonomy. In your practice, not only should you focus on physical rehabilitation, but also consider its potential benefits for patients' mental health.

items.summaryZh: 一项包含 5 项 RCT 的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，与传统康复相比，虚拟现实辅助物理治疗能显著改善膝骨关节炎患者的疼痛（SMD = 0.40）、身体功能（SMD = 0.37）和平衡（SMD = 0.44）。
items.curatedReasonEn: VR-assisted physiotherapy significantly improves pain, physical function, and balance in knee osteoarthritis. For KOA patients who respond poorly to traditional methods or have low adherence, consider VR as a valuable adjunct.
items.limitation: 本系统综述仅纳入 5 项 RCT，研究数量相对较少，可能影响结果的稳定性。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review included only 5 RCTs, a relatively small number of studies, which may affect the robustness of the results.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Association of combined physical and cognitive rehabilitation with post-stroke dementia: a U.S. multicenter retrospective cohort study.
items.summary: A U.S. multicenter retrospective cohort study of 958 propensity score-matched stroke patients (≥55 years) with mild cognitive impairment found that combined physical and cognitive rehabilitation was associated with a significantly reduced risk of post-stroke dementia (HR = 0.58, 95% CI: 0.44-0.78, P < 0.001) compared to physical rehabilitation alone.
items.curatedReason: 这项美国多中心回顾性队列研究提示，结合物理和认知康复可以降低卒中后痴呆的风险。在处理卒中后伴有轻度认知障碍的患者时，你应将认知康复纳入你的康复方案，以期获得更好的长期认知结局。
items.titleZh: 综合物理和认知康复与卒中后痴呆关联性：一项美国多中心回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 958 名经过倾向评分匹配的卒中患者（≥55 岁）进行的美国多中心回顾性队列研究发现，与单独进行物理康复相比，综合物理和认知康复与卒中后痴呆风险显著降低相关（HR = 0.58, 95% CI: 0.44-0.78, P < 0.001）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This U.S. multicenter retrospective cohort study suggests that combined physical and cognitive rehabilitation can reduce the risk of post-stroke dementia. When managing stroke patients with mild cognitive impairment, you should integrate cognitive rehabilitation into your treatment plan for better long-term cognitive outcomes.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列研究，虽然进行了倾向匹配，但仍无法完全排除混杂因素的影响。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective cohort study, despite propensity score matching, cannot entirely rule out the influence of confounding factors.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: The RESOLVE Trial: A Stepped-Wedge, Cluster-Randomized Clinical Trial Evaluating the Effects of Clinical Practice Guidelines and Psychologically Informed Physical Therapy on Low Back Pain Outcomes in Service Members and Veterans.
items.summary: A stepped-wedge, cluster-randomized trial showed that implementing clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) alongside psychologically informed physical therapy (PIPT) significantly reduced low back pain-related disability and pain in military and veteran health care settings.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，将临床实践指南与心理知情物理治疗（PIPT）相结合的实施策略，在退伍军人和军人中能有效减少下腰痛相关残疾和疼痛。你可以参考其干预策略，优化你的 LBP 管理方案，尤其是在多学科背景下。
items.titleZh: RESOLVE 试验：评估临床实践指南与心理知情物理治疗对军人与退伍军人下腰痛结局影响的阶梯楔形、整群随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项阶梯楔形、整群随机试验显示，在军事和退伍军人医疗环境中，结合临床实践指南（CPGs）和心理知情物理治疗（PIPT）的实施策略，显著降低了下腰痛相关残疾和疼痛。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that implementing clinical practice guidelines combined with psychologically informed physical therapy (PIPT) effectively reduces low back pain-related disability and pain in service members and veterans. You can use this intervention strategy to optimize your LBP management, especially in multidisciplinary settings.
items.limitation: 这是一项在军事和退伍军人医疗机构进行的多中心研究，其结果可能不完全适用于普通民用诊所。
items.limitationEn: This was a multicenter study conducted in military and veteran healthcare settings, and its findings may not be fully generalizable to civilian clinics.

items.title: Long-term benefits of ultrasound-guided percutaneous electrical nerve stimulation for chronic lateral elbow pain: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized, double-blinded, sham-controlled trial with 49 participants found that ultrasound-guided percutaneous electrical nerve stimulation, combined with exercise, provided mid- and long-term benefits for chronic lateral elbow pain.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 证实，超声引导的经皮电神经刺激结合运动疗法，对慢性肱骨外上髁炎患者具有中长期益处。在处理传统方法效果不佳的网球肘时，你可以把这个作为一种有效的辅助方案。
items.titleZh: 超声引导经皮电神经刺激治疗慢性肱骨外上髁炎的长期益处：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 49 名参与者的随机、双盲、假对照试验发现，超声引导经皮电神经刺激结合运动疗法，对慢性肱骨外上髁炎具有中长期益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT confirms that ultrasound-guided percutaneous electrical nerve stimulation combined with exercise offers mid- to long-term benefits for chronic lateral epicondylitis. When managing tennis elbow resistant to traditional methods, you can consider this an effective adjunctive treatment.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量为 49 名参与者，相对较小，可能需要更大规模的研究来进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The study included 49 participants, which is relatively small and may require larger studies for further validation.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Content validity, reliability, and agreement between in-person and video-call assessments of the modified bradykinesia rating scale (MBRS).
items.summary: The Modified Bradykinesia Rating Scale (MBRS) demonstrated adequate content validity, excellent test-retest reliability (ICC = 0.94-0.97) and inter-rater reliability (ICC = 0.82-0.97), and good agreement between in-person and video-call assessments in individuals with Parkinson's disease.
items.curatedReason: 改良运动迟缓评定量表（MBRS）在帕金森病评估中展现了良好的内容效度、重测信度和评定者间信度，并且现场评估和视频通话评估之间具有一致性。未来在帕金森病患者的远程评估中，你可以考虑使用 MBRS。
items.titleZh: 改良运动迟缓评定量表（MBRS）的内容效度、信度及现场与视频通话评估的一致性研究
items.summaryZh: 改良运动迟缓评定量表（MBRS）在帕金森病患者中表现出足够的内容效度、出色的重测信度（ICC = 0.94-0.97）和评定者间信度（ICC = 0.82-0.97），以及现场和视频通话评估之间良好的一致性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Modified Bradykinesia Rating Scale (MBRS) shows good content validity, test-retest reliability, and inter-rater reliability for Parkinson's disease assessment, with consistency between in-person and video-call assessments. You can consider using MBRS for remote assessment of Parkinson's patients in the future.
items.limitation: 本研究未提供 MBRS 在不同帕金森病分期或严重程度患者中的表现细节。
items.limitationEn: This study did not provide details on MBRS performance across different Parkinson's disease stages or severity levels.

items.title: In adult patients with brainstem strokes, does dysphagia rehabilitation improve health-related outcomes compared to usual care for inpatients? A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 12 studies (443 participants) concluded that dysphagia rehabilitation, including traditional swallowing therapy and device inclusion, is effective for improving swallow function in inpatients with brainstem stroke.
items.curatedReason: 脑干卒中住院患者的吞咽困难康复是有效的。你应当积极采纳传统吞咽治疗或结合设备干预，这项包含443名患者的系统综述证实了这些方法的疗效。
items.titleZh: 脑干卒中成人患者吞咽困难康复是否比常规住院治疗更能改善健康相关结局？一项系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 12 项研究（443 名参与者）的系统综述和 Meta 分析得出结论，吞咽困难康复，包括传统吞咽治疗和设备辅助，能有效改善脑干卒中住院患者的吞咽功能。
items.curatedReasonEn: Dysphagia rehabilitation for inpatients with brainstem stroke is effective. You should confidently implement traditional swallowing therapy or device-assisted interventions, as this systematic review of 443 participants confirms their efficacy.
items.limitation: 研究纳入的 RCT 数量有限，且不同干预措施之间的比较受异质性影响。
items.limitationEn: The number of included RCTs is limited, and comparisons between different interventions are affected by heterogeneity.

items.title: A Multimodal Assessment of Gastric Motility, reflux risk, and Clinical Efficacy: Intermittent Oro-Esophageal versus Nasogastric Tube Feeding for Post-Stroke Dysphagia in a Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A single-center RCT with 54 post-stroke dysphagia patients found that intermittent oro-esophageal tube feeding (IOE) was superior to nasogastric tube feeding (NG) for reducing gastric retention volume (40.5 ± 25.3 ml vs. 79.2 ± 36.1 ml, p < 0.001) and reflux risk (4.2% vs. 20.8%, p = 0.02) after 14 days, while supporting swallowing recovery.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照试验表明，间歇性口咽管饲法与鼻胃管饲法相比，在卒中后吞咽困难患者中减少了胃潴留和反流风险。在管理有吞咽困难的卒中患者时，你现在有证据支持考虑间歇性口咽管饲法作为一种替代选择，以优化胃肠道管理。
items.titleZh: 间歇性口咽管饲法与鼻胃管饲法治疗卒中后吞咽困难的多模态评估：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 54 名卒中后吞咽困难患者的单中心随机对照试验发现，在支持吞咽恢复的同时，间歇性口咽管饲法（IOE）在 14 天后在减少胃潴留量（40.5 ± 25.3 ml vs. 79.2 ± 36.1 ml, p < 0.001）和反流风险（4.2% vs. 20.8%, p = 0.02）方面优于鼻胃管饲法（NG）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT indicates that intermittent oro-esophageal tube feeding reduces gastric retention and reflux risk in post-stroke dysphagia patients compared to nasogastric tube feeding. When managing stroke patients with dysphagia, you now have evidence to consider intermittent oro-esophageal tube feeding as an alternative option to optimize gastrointestinal management.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心随机对照试验，样本量相对较小（54 名参与者），结果需要多中心大样本研究进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center randomized controlled trial with a relatively small sample size (54 participants), and its results require further validation by larger, multicenter studies.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Responsiveness of the Arabic version of the lower extremity functional scale in individuals with lower extremity musculoskeletal disorders.
items.summary: The Arabic version of the Lower Extremity Functional Scale (LEFS) showed good responsiveness in 74 individuals with lower extremity musculoskeletal disorders, demonstrating significant correlations with other outcome measures.
items.curatedReason: LEFS 的阿拉伯语版在低肢肌肉骨骼疾病患者中表现出良好的反应性，你可以将其纳入阿拉伯语患者群体的评估工具箱。
items.titleZh: 阿拉伯语版下肢功能量表在下肢肌肉骨骼疾病患者中的反应性研究
items.summaryZh: 阿拉伯语版下肢功能量表（LEFS）在 74 名下肢肌肉骨骼疾病患者中显示出良好的反应性，与其他结局指标有显著相关性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Arabic version of LEFS demonstrates good responsiveness in individuals with lower extremity musculoskeletal disorders, making it a viable addition to your assessment toolkit for Arabic-speaking patients.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量为 74 名参与者，可能限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study included 74 participants, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Adherence to exercise intervention including pain threshold, exercise and physiotherapy sessions for patients with chronic rotator cuff tendinopathy.
items.summary: This study investigated adherence to two pain threshold protocols during a 26-week exercise intervention for chronic rotator cuff tendinopathy in 84 patients, providing insights into patient compliance patterns.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性肩袖肌腱病患者，患者对26周运动干预中疼痛阈值方案的依从性，我们知之甚少。这项观察研究提示，理解依从性模式有助于你在长期运动方案中，更好地预判和调整治疗策略。
items.titleZh: 慢性肩袖肌腱病患者在包含疼痛阈值、运动和物理治疗的干预方案中的依从性研究
items.summaryZh: 本研究调查了 84 名慢性肩袖肌腱病患者在 26 周运动干预中对两种疼痛阈值方案的依从性，为患者依从性模式提供了见解。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic rotator cuff tendinopathy, patient adherence to pain threshold protocols during a 26-week exercise intervention is a blind spot. This observational study suggests that understanding these adherence patterns can help you better anticipate and adjust treatment strategies in long-term exercise programs.
items.limitation: 本研究是 RCT 的次级数据分析，可能存在原始试验设计未完全覆盖本依从性研究需求的问题。
items.limitationEn: This study is a secondary data analysis of an RCT, which might have limitations regarding the original trial design not fully addressing the needs of this adherence study.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: The Association of Depression, Anxiety, and Quality of Life with Sexual Function in Young-to-Middle-Aged Stroke Patients: A Case-Control Study.
items.summary: A case-control study of 30 stroke patients found significantly higher rates of sexual dysfunction (ASEX total scores: 19.3 ± 6.6 vs. 13.0 ± 3.1, p < 0.001) and a significant decline in sexual satisfaction (7.5 to 4.1, p < 0.001) compared to controls, with associations to depression, anxiety, and quality of life.
items.curatedReason: 这项病例对照研究强调了卒中患者性功能障碍的高患病率及其与抑郁、焦虑和生活质量的关联。在康复计划中，你应当更积极地评估和讨论卒中患者的性健康需求。
items.titleZh: 年轻至中年卒中患者抑郁、焦虑和生活质量与性功能的关系：一项病例对照研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 30 名卒中患者进行的病例对照研究发现，与对照组相比，卒中患者的性功能障碍发生率显著更高（ASEX 总分：19.3 ± 6.6 vs. 13.0 ± 3.1, p < 0.001），性满意度显著下降（7.5 降至 4.1, p < 0.001），并与抑郁、焦虑及生活质量相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case-control study highlights the high prevalence of sexual dysfunction in stroke patients and its association with depression, anxiety, and quality of life. You should more proactively assess and discuss sexual health needs in stroke rehabilitation plans.
items.limitation: 本研究的样本量相对较小（30 名卒中患者和 30 名对照），可能限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study's relatively small sample size (30 stroke patients and 30 controls) may limit the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Information and communication technologies in implementation strategies promoting allied health professionals' guideline adherence in post-acute stroke care: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review identified and mapped various information and communication technologies (ICTs) used in implementation strategies to promote allied health professionals' guideline adherence in post-acute stroke care.
items.curatedReason: 这份范围综述识别了信息和通信技术（ICTs）在卒中后康复中辅助专职医疗人员遵循指南的潜力。你可以从中了解现有 ICT 工具的范围及其在改善指南依从性方面的应用，考虑在实践中进行整合。
items.titleZh: 信息和通信技术在促进专职医疗人员卒中后康复指南依从性实施策略中的应用：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述识别并绘制了信息和通信技术（ICTs）在实施策略中，用于促进专职医疗人员在卒中后康复中遵守指南的应用情况。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review identifies the potential of Information and Communication Technologies (ICTs) to support allied health professionals in adhering to guidelines for post-acute stroke care. You can use this to understand the range of existing ICT tools and their application in improving guideline adherence, and consider integrating them into your practice.
items.limitation: 这是一项范围综述，主要侧重于识别和映射 ICTs 的应用，而非评估其干预效果的量化数据。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review, primarily focused on identifying and mapping ICT applications rather than quantifying their intervention effects.

items.title: Correlation of Motor-Task Related Brain Activation Changes With Motor Performance Changes Induced by Constraint-Induced Therapy After Stroke.
items.summary: In 42 hemiparetic stroke participants, fMRI revealed changes in motor-task related brain activation correlated with functional recovery (Wolf Motor Function Test) after Constraint-Induced Movement Therapy (CIMT) during subacute and chronic periods.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提供了卒中后约束诱导运动疗法（CIMT）导致运动任务相关脑激活变化与运动功能恢复之间关系的神经影像学证据。你可以将这些发现作为理解 CIMT 机制的背景信息，但在临床实践上，仍应以 CIMT 的行为学证据为主。
items.titleZh: 卒中后约束诱导疗法引起的运动任务相关脑激活变化与运动表现变化的相关性
items.summaryZh: 在 42 名偏瘫卒中患者中，fMRI 显示，亚急性期和慢性期约束诱导运动疗法（CIMT）后，运动任务相关的脑激活变化与运动功能恢复（Wolf 运动功能测试）相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study provides neuroimaging evidence on the relationship between motor-task related brain activation changes and motor performance recovery induced by Constraint-Induced Movement Therapy (CIMT) after stroke. You can use these findings as background to understand CIMT mechanisms, but clinical practice should still prioritize behavioral evidence of CIMT.
items.limitation: 研究样本量为 42 名，且集中在亚急性期和慢性期，结果可能无法直接推广到所有卒中患者。
items.limitationEn: The study included 42 participants, focusing on subacute and chronic phases, so the results may not be directly generalizable to all stroke patients.

items.title: Enhancing dynamic postural stability during gait in Parkinson's disease with textured insoles and auditory cue training: a randomized controlled trial study.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial with 27 Parkinson's disease patients (Hoehn & Yahr stages 2.5-3) found that combining textured insoles with auditory cues significantly improved dynamic postural stability during gait compared to textured insoles alone or progressive walking training.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 提示，在帕金森病患者中，结合纹理鞋垫和听觉提示的训练能比单独使用纹理鞋垫或普通步行训练更好地增强步态中的动态姿势稳定性。在处理帕金森病患者的步态和平衡障碍时，你可以考虑这种多模态干预作为更优方案。
items.titleZh: 纹理鞋垫与听觉提示训练在帕金森病患者中增强步态动态姿势稳定性：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 27 名帕金森病患者（Hoehn & Yahr 2.5-3 期）进行的随机对照试验发现，结合纹理鞋垫和听觉提示的训练，与单独使用纹理鞋垫或渐进式步行训练相比，能显著改善步态中的动态姿势稳定性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that training combining textured insoles and auditory cues enhances dynamic postural stability during gait in Parkinson's disease patients better than textured insoles alone or progressive walking training. For Parkinson's patients with gait and balance impairments, you can consider this multimodal intervention as a superior option.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（27 名参与者），且主要集中在 Hoehn & Yahr 2.5-3 期的患者，结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (27 participants) and focused primarily on patients in Hoehn & Yahr stages 2.5-3, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Exploring facilitators and barriers to health behaviors in stroke survivors: a multi-perspective qualitative study of patients, families, and healthcare professionals.
items.summary: A qualitative study in Shanghai, China, conducted semi-structured interviews with 17 stroke survivors, 10 family caregivers, and 11 healthcare professionals, identifying facilitators and barriers to post-stroke health behaviors for secondary prevention.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究提供了卒中幸存者、家属和医疗专业人员对二级预防健康行为促进和障碍的多视角见解。在制定个性化康复计划时，你可以借鉴这些发现来更好地理解患者及其家庭的需求和挑战。
items.titleZh: 探讨卒中幸存者健康行为的促进因素和障碍：一项多视角定性研究（患者、家属和医疗专业人员）
items.summaryZh: 一项在中国上海进行的定性研究，通过对 17 名卒中幸存者、10 名家庭照护者和 11 名医疗专业人员进行半结构化访谈，识别了卒中后二级预防健康行为的促进因素和障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study offers multi-perspective insights from stroke survivors, families, and healthcare professionals on facilitators and barriers to secondary prevention health behaviors. When creating individualized rehabilitation plans, you can use these findings to better understand patient and family needs and challenges.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小，结果不具统计学代表性，主要提供深层理解而非普遍性结论。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size, is not statistically representative, and primarily offers in-depth understanding rather than generalizable conclusions.

items.title: Examination and treatment of the spine for upper extremity pain: a case series.
items.summary: This case series describes three patients with upper extremity pain who achieved significant improvements with spine mobilization or manipulation techniques, suggesting the spine as a potential source of symptoms even with atypical pain referral patterns.
items.curatedReason: 这个病例系列提示，上肢疼痛患者的脊柱功能障碍可能是症状来源。在评估上肢疼痛患者时，你应考虑全面检查脊柱，特别是当症状模式不典型时。
items.titleZh: 针对上肢疼痛的脊柱检查和治疗：一个病例系列
items.summaryZh: 本病例系列描述了三名上肢疼痛患者通过脊柱松动或手法治疗取得显著改善，提示即使疼痛模式不典型，脊柱也可能是症状的潜在来源。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case series suggests that spinal dysfunction may be a source of symptoms in patients with upper extremity pain. When evaluating patients with upper extremity pain, you should consider a comprehensive spinal examination, especially when symptom patterns are atypical.
items.limitation: 这是一个小样本的病例系列研究，证据等级较低，无法得出普遍性结论。
items.limitationEn: This is a small case series with a low level of evidence, making it impossible to draw generalizable conclusions.
